rules.text: When website functions are enabled, eligible enabled functions on that number can be offered to visitors. A visitor ID groups a conversation and cannot authorise access to your own customer records.
rules.why: The website allows tools by number and checks their ownership and active state.

rules.text: Putting a new action tag like [BOOK_NOW] in a prompt does not create a function.
rules.instead: Configure a number-scoped function with its argument schema, or use a supported phone booking integration.

rules.text: A configured function can call your service with validated arguments. Make each public function safe for its intended audience.
Choose a supported name, HTTPS destination and HTTP method. Keep credentials in trusted configuration and return only the response fields the agent needs.
Function names must start with a lowercase letter and use lowercase letters, digits or underscores. A name must be unique for the number.
List a number’s existing functions before adding one.
On duplicate_function choose a unique name or update the intended existing function by ID.
